Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.usageinsight.popularity

package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.usageinsight.popularity
Provides the member popularity profiler, which totals the usage activity of the members of each collection and records it in the collection's MemberPopularityProfile classification.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    LovelacePopularityProfilerService
    LovelacePopularityProfilerService maintains the MemberPopularityProfile classification of each root collection, glossary, data sharing hub, collection folder and digital product catalog.
    LovelacePopularityProfilerServiceProvider
    LovelacePopularityProfilerServiceProvider is the connector provider for the Lovelace Popularity Profiler governance action service.
    MemberActivity
    MemberActivity holds the seven usage activity counts for an element: the counts from its own UsageActivity classification, plus - for a collection - the totals of the activity of its members.
